messages:
Maria (CS): Heads up — we're observing authentication 401s for a small group of EU onboarders starting ~04:12 UTC. I exported an impacted roster (15 total: 11 trials, 4 onboarders). Placing here to align comms and remediation. Link: https://go/internal/cs/impacted-sso (view only).
Noah (eng-oncall): Looking into it. Backend logs show provider returning invalid_client on /oauth/token. Seems provider rotated a client secret and our eu-1 adapter missed the update. Kicked off a key-sync job to secretstore-eu, aiming for a rollback-free resync within 30m.
Ajay (Product): Which customers are in the affected set? Any approaching renewals or active pilots?
Maria (CS): Impacted enterprise: BrightCo (onboarding, renewal in ~4 weeks), Acme Corp (pilot), EduWave (pilot). BrightCo + Acme flagged as high-touch.
Erin (CS Ops): Recommend proactive remediation: 1) Send targeted status to impacted accounts, 2) Offer 1:1 onboarding slots to enterprises, 3) Apply trial credits for affected trials. I can start booking sessions now.
Sara (Legal): Credits ok but watch language. Don't use definitive SLA phrases. Use "we apologize for the inconvenience" and avoid statements like "we caused this".
deploy-bot: key-sync-job: started for sso-eu (job-id 2026-04-15-0420)
Noah (eng-oncall): Key-sync completed 04:40 UTC. All provider keys resynced into secretstore-eu. Token error rate dropped to baseline. Monitoring for 30m for any regression. Root cause: provider secret rotation + missing key-rotation webhook for eu-1. Remediation planned: add webhook + health alert + region smoke test.
Maria (CS): Drafting immediate customer note: will (a) acknowledge disruption, (b) note restoration time, (c) provide quick troubleshooting steps if they still see 401s, (d) explain credits & offer hands-on help. Posting draft below for Legal review.
Maria (CS): --- CUSTOMER STATUS DRAFT ---
Hi <CustomerName>,
We wanted to let you know about a brief authentication issue you may have noticed during onboarding today. Some EU-based sign-ins experienced SSO token failures; service was restored for affected users as of 04:40 UTC. If you continue to encounter 401s, please try a fresh browser sign-in and include the request timestamp and trace header (x-rw-trace) when you reply so our team can investigate quickly.
We apologize for the inconvenience. As a goodwill gesture, weve applied a two-week credit for affected trials and scheduled a complimentary 1:1 onboarding session for affected enterprise customers. To book troubleshooting office hours, please use: https://cal.link/redwood-cs/office-hours.
If you have questions, reply to this message or contact your CS rep directly.
---
Noah (eng-oncall): Suggest small tweak — ask for both `x-rw-trace` and the request timestamp to speed log correlation.
Maria (CS): Updated to request trace + timestamp.
Erin (CS Ops): I'll send targeted notes to BrightCo and Acme and schedule 1:1s. I'll log any client feedback in the CS feedback tracker (sheet: https://go/internal/cs/feedback) and capture renewal cues.
Ajay (Product): Tracking action items: Eng to add key-rotation webhook + alert (owner: Noah, ETA EOW), Infra to implement regionized secret-sync smoke test (owner: ops, ETA 2 weeks), CS to send status + book credits/sessions (owner: Maria/Erin, ETA today), Legal to approve final copy (owner: Sara, ETA 30m).
Sara (Legal): Draft approved with one wording change: prefer "we apologize for the inconvenience" and replace "we restored service" with "service was restored for affected users as of 04:40 UTC".
Maria (CS): Finalized per Legal. Planning to send at 05:05 UTC to impacted list and post a brief portal notice. We'll follow up with a full RCA in 4872 hours after postmortem. Erin — DM me outcomes from the calls so I can annotate renewal-risk tracker. :heart:
deploy-bot: key-sync-job: success (job-id 2026-04-15-0420) — 100 keys synced
Noah (eng-oncall): Monitoring shows error rate returned to baseline ~04:45 UTC. Postmortem scheduled 09:00 UTC; will include timeline, log excerpts, and remediation plan (webhook + smoke tests + runbook).
Erin (CS Ops): Sending messages now. I'll update Acme/BrightCo call notes and any renewal indicators into the renewal-risk sheet.
Maria (CS): Sent customer updates at 05:07 UTC. Will escalate to execs if any replies indicate churn risk or legal concern.
